id./param/scenario/cs/b_160_cs_010.pack|cs_: "*sniff* *sniff*...
"That voice... It can't be...
"Is that you... Sister?
"S-Serena...? Oh, {var:1}'s here too.

"{var:1}, I was so lonely.
  I've been alone this whole time...

"Listen, {var:1}.
  I have just one favor to ask.
"Could you die right now...?

"I died protecting you, remember?
  It's not fair if only you get to live, is it?

"Die! Atone with your own death!
  I wanted to live so much longer,
  and it's all because of you!
"Begone, foul phantom.

"My noble sister would never
  say such words.
  You are not my sister.
"Graaaargh...!!

"Sister held onto hope to the very end.
  She regrets nothing.

"Only one man would show us
  such a sickening sight!
"Show yourself... Jasper!

"Love for a dear sister... Heh heh heh,
  so that's love. How trivial. How worthless...

"Hendrik. Still alive, I see?
  Your tenacity is as admirable as ever.
  Your stubbornness deserves respect.

"Well, you've come all this way, but
  beyond lies Lord Mordegon's domain.
  You vermin have no business entering.
"I'd love to see you out right now, but...

"Insects, you got this far!
  As a keepsake, Spectral Sentinel Jasper
  shall bury you himself!

"Ha ha ha! How about it, Hendrik!
  Behold this body! This magic!
  I have gained power to surpass you!

"Jasper...
  Have you truly become a monster...?

"Come! I shall offer your corpses
  to Lord Mordegon!
